Qt / PySide6 – source and replacement information

Runtime versions are recorded in Runtime_Inventory.json. The distributed Qt and
PySide6 libraries are unmodified and dynamically loaded from _internal/PySide6.
The LGPLv3 and incorporated GPLv3 texts are included in this directory.

Corresponding upstream source locations and build instructions:
https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/
https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtbase.git/
https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtwebengine.git/
https://code.qt.io/cgit/pyside/pyside-setup.git/
https://doc.qt.io/qtforpython-6/building_from_source/index.html
https://download.documentfoundation.org/libreoffice/src/

Users may replace LGPL libraries with compatible builds, and may reverse engineer
or debug EmailCenter as necessary to modify or replace those libraries. This
package imposes no restriction on those rights. Qt's DLLs are distributed
separately; rebuilding or replacing a library does not require modifying the
installer. Use the recorded versions and upstream build instructions.

Python's own LICENSE.txt and LibreOffice's full licensing/third-party notices
are included with their respective runtimes. EmailCenter source/build scripts
are provided separately with the release; no user tokens or projects are included.
